adoption: Not adopted; no product source changed
conclusion: No convincing tap-to-ready benefit in this small crossover probe. Median heldBlank tap was768.08ms versus748.21ms without extra blank; including initialization1426.47ms versus749.37ms. Keep original runtime and discard the blank-keepalive hypothesis as an optimization candidate for this scope.
safety: All3 warm cases proved about:blank, unique title, complete, zero observed resources, exact named profile, held through genuine ready, and weak WK object release within1second. Fresh user content controller has no installed host handlers/scripts by construction.
limits: Preparation is common and reported once; HTTP caches are not cleared or re-downloaded between alternating cases
WebKit/JIT/network process state can carry over across cases; this small mechanism probe is not a 30 percent target result
Profile/cleanup checks are experimental guards, not verification of real account-generation races
Public SDK does not guarantee that a held blank view shares a WebContent process with the fresh game
Warm creation/wait and full start-to-genuine-ready costs use native uptime; no document/server clock subtraction
Weak WK object release is not proof of process termination, RSS release or exclusive game memory
RSS from macOS ps, not physical footprint, JS heap, unique allocations or a leak detector. Native test host includes XCTest; it is separate from WebContent.

Only PIDs explicitly observed as WebContent in this exact YunleFun test-host log are sampled, checked for executable basename and stable process start time. Prior WebContent can remain alive; no RSS sum is called the active game memory.
Case intervals follow when BEGIN/END log markers are observed by this monitor; log delivery and polling delays remain, not exact cross-clock alignment.
Simulator and observer overhead; no real-device memory/frame claim; no credentials, environment, argv or descriptors collected.
hasHostBridge is a narrow probe for absence of window.ylf, not an exhaustive bridge inspection; empty constructed controller is the stronger source evidence.

RSS windows are short, some cases have no WebContent sample. A missing sample does not prove absent process. Multiple per-PID RSS values are never added as exclusive memory, and PIDs are not assigned to blank/game solely by timing.
No adopted product change, no N10 or30percent acceptance, no hidden gameplay. Prior Star opening and target unchanged.
